Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Steel Slanted Lines Wool Modern Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8'
Colors: Steel
Materials: steel
45% Viscose, 40% Wool, 15% Cotton Imported With its contrasting shades and modern geometric design, this versatile rug is ideal for contemporary, medium-traffic rooms. Hand-tufted in India with a wool and viscose blend, it wears well with time. Runner rug features a neutral-toned geometric pattern Hand-tufted with a wool/viscose blend Plush .6'' pile suits medium-traffic, indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 2'6 x 8' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
